properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-03: a write that REMOVED a property reported `changed: false`, "nothing moved", and kept no snapshot of what it removed. revision_of and preserve_prior compared only the properties the node still held, so a removal was invisible to both
properties.source: fix program item 8, --call on a scratch store with the main binary at 293f957
properties.statement: FOUND while making external_dependency reply with a receipt (fix program item 8). On main at 293f957, `--call create_node` with {"rationale": null} on a requirement holding a 29-character rationale removed it and listed it under `unset`, and its `revision` said `changed: false`, `replaced: []`, "This node already held exactly what this call passed; nothing moved." No preserved-on-write snapshot was taken. The same blindness is why a dependency re-declare that dropped a description said nothing (fact:re-declaring-a-dependency-drops-the-resources-description-2026-09-23): crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/capture.rs revision_of iterated the NEW properties only, and preserve_prior likewise. Fixed in the same change: a removed property is listed in `replaced` with its prior value and named in `removed`, counted in `shortened`, and preserved. Pinned by a_write_that_removes_a_property_says_what_left_and_keeps_it.
